primary.scope: LAR-Young-like flight/ground findings and pathways only
criteria: gene/pathway q-value threshold fixed in protocol before loading OSD-102 results
pathway replication judged on fixed pathway list and direction

context_mapping.scope: fixed lipid/ECM/tubular remodeling panel; non-directional context mapping rather than strict replication
criteria: fixed feature list before loading cohort results
reported as context_detected when q <= threshold
not counted as confirmatory replicated unless a nonzero directional discovery_effect is registered
